# Bundled libraries (for offline use)

These are unmodified copies so A.R.T.E.M.I.S. runs with no internet connection.

| File | Library | License |
|---|---|---|
| `chart.umd.js` | Chart.js 4.4.1 | MIT (header in file) |
| `three/three.min.js` | Three.js r147 | MIT (header in file) |
| `three/GLTFLoader.js`, `three/RoomEnvironment.js` | Three.js r147 examples | MIT |
| `fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-latin-wght.woff2` | Plus Jakarta Sans (variable, Latin) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`fonts/OFL.txt`) |
